DialogDelete.Description: All current status effects will be permanently deleted and cannot be recovered.

StatusEffectsMenu.Name: Status Effects
StatusEffectsMenu.Hint: Configure the status effects that are available

HideDefaultStatusEffects.Name: Hide Default Status Effects
HideDefaultStatusEffects.Hint: If enabled, the default token HUD status effects button will be hidden

Config.Summary: This is where you can configure the status effects that will appear on the token HUD. You can drag and drop effects from items, actors, or the Convenient Effects application.
Config.HowTo: Drag and drop some active effects (from an item, actor, or the Convenient Effects app) or create a new one below to start.
